topics.title: AssemblyScript CDN App Constraints
topics.description: This document is for **agents** generating AssemblyScript code for FastEdge CDN apps. These are hard constraints — not style preferences — enforced by the AssemblyScript compiler and the WebAssembly runtime. Violating them produces code that either fails to compile or traps at ru

sections.heading: No default parameters on nested functions
`||` does not fall back on empty strings
Array higher-order methods require explicit type parameters
String concatenation does not auto-coerce numeric types
Use `changetype<T>` for pointer casts — not `as T`
No dynamic property access on class instances
`Map` requires primitive or value-comparable key types

topics.title: Best Practices — Agent Quality Guidance
topics.description: This document is for **agents** building FastEdge applications on a user's behalf. It is not a tutorial or an API reference. It is a set of behavioral rules that distinguish a high-quality FastEdge agent from one that papers over uncertainty.

topics.title: CDN Integration — Attaching FastEdge Apps to CDN Resources
topics.description: FastEdge **CDN apps** (proxy-wasm filters) run inside Gcore's CDN proxy layer rather than as standalone HTTP handlers. topics.title: FastEdge Error Codes
topics.description: FastEdge returns specific HTTP status codes (530-533) when the Wasm runtime encounters issues. These replace the standard 5xx codes to distinguish edge runtime errors from origin server errors.

topics.title: FastEdge HTTP Apps as CDN Origins
topics.description: FastEdge **HTTP apps** (`wasi-http`) can be used as the origin for a CDN resource — either as the resource's default origin or on specific URL paths via CDN rules. This routes CDN traffic directly to a FastEdge app instead of a conventional web server.

topics.title: Operational Knobs
topics.description: Some FastEdge platform settings are short-lived or have time-bounded behavior an agent must surface to the user before acting. This document collects those — settings that won't be obvious from the API schema alone but materially affect what works at any given moment.

topics.title: FastEdge Platform Overview
topics.description: Gcore FastEdge runs WebAssembly (Wasm) workloads at the edge on Gcore's global CDN infrastructure. When a request arrives at a PoP, the Wasm runtime instantiates the app, processes the request, and returns the response — all within the same PoP, minimizing latency.
